provenance.basis: local owned live fixtures on Hyprland 0.56.2; root local verification, not external third party
provenance.design: desktop 36 blocks x10 (3 rounds; R1 ABBA, R2 BAAB, R3 ABBA), 360 measured + 0 warmup; CDP 24 normal blocks x20 (10/mode, R1 ABBA, R2 BAAB, R3 ABBA), 480 measured + 48 warmup; CDP image 6 blocks x5, 30 measured + 6 warmup
provenance.raw_source: private desktop-controlled-runs/ (36 files) and cdp-controlled-runs/ (30 files); hashes below identify them, files not published

method.paired_ci: chronological adjacent block-median differences; 10000 bootstrap draws, seed 0; 6 pairs per normal cell, 3 per image cell
method.timing_scope_desktop: fresh observe + action construction + checkpoint write/fsync + act + independent app verification; session/setup/model outside
method.timing_scope_cdp: observe + act + independent app verification; setup outside

fixed_gates.desktop_guard_crop: all 3 rounds gain>0 AND per-round p95 regression <=5%, paired CI95 lower bound >0, pooled candidate p95 <= baseline p95 x1.05

notes.visual_tokens: UNVERIFIED; PNG+JSON bytes are proxies only, not billed tokens
notes.image_overlap: image result_bytes embed base64 PNG data, so JSON and PNG byte metrics overlap; never add them, never divide image JSON by 4 to claim model tokens
notes.desktop_heuristic: desktop result_bytes/4 may be quoted only as explicitly naive heuristic; visual/billed tokens remain UNVERIFIED
notes.integration: measured isolation experiment only; root owns integration and final verification; rejected sleep-removal and cross-guard query-caching candidates NOT LANDED; R3 poll-interval gain stays R3
